scope: Separate betse_spatial_passive@1 compatibility kernel: freely evolving trajectories from native initial state and static geometry, field and transport inputs on the pinned seven-cell/30-patch/10x10-grid panel. Four synthetic passive cases at two native steps over 8 microseconds. No evolving native values are fed into Cells.
checks: Authenticate prior native capture, observed/bare neutrality and independent update accounting without changing frozen artifacts
Reconstruct Dirichlet operator from grid topology, solve on selected device, compare discrete harmonic functions and captured native boundary operator without importing its inverse
Native sigma=1 zero-padded screened-charge field, distinct patch voltage convention, native q/kb drift and reversed edge derivatives
Freely evolving full concentration/membrane-lag/field/flux histories at every completed native step, four cases and both native timesteps
Separate per-species/per-grid-site reservoir reset and native stencil ledgers; membrane/junction exchange and local/global material accounting
Complete state replay across disk restart, changed integration windows, mapped worlds and partitions; continuation includes lagged membrane concentrations
Invalid layouts and negative/nonfinite trials reject without clipping or advancing state; damaged geometry/field/ledgers and omitted membrane lag are detected
CPU/L4 complete histories and float64 device placement, GPU-busy and measured SM-active with coverage
scope_exclusions: Pinned passive nonpolarizable FULL INIT mode only; no pumps, intrinsic channels, calcium chemistry, assembly, mechanics, noise or biological calibration
Separate native compatibility law; qualified resolved capacitor/return-current models are unchanged
Native edge stencil can add/remove net material independently of boundary resets; these terms are recorded explicitly, not claimed to be a conservative finite-volume scheme
No thermodynamic energy balance is asserted for the native screened-field/update law
Eight microsecond matched-step panel, not a longer-duration, timestep-convergence or spatial-refinement qualification
Bounded dense boundary solver up to 256 grid sites, static geometry and held boundaries; no sparse/distributed tissue or remote multi-GPU execution claim
Reusable numerical component with full-state scan/replay; ordinary model-registry integration is subsequent work
Whole GPU phase includes compilation and host checks; no single warmed throughput interval
